text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "For the host country, however, the situation is somewhat different.", "gist": "The situation differs for the host country."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "no one individual is considered to be head of state in Switzerland", "gist": "Switzerland has no single individual recognized as head of state"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the President of the Swiss Confederation should be accorded the same standing as his or her foreign counterparts", "gist": "Swiss Confederation President must receive equal status to foreign heads of state"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "other countries regard these occasions when they invite or receive the Swiss president as a ‘state visit’", "gist": "Other countries classify meetings with Swiss president as state visits"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "the term is therefore perfectly appropriate", "gist": "The term 'state visit' is therefore suitable"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "It is up to the country issuing the invitation to decide whether it is for a working visit, an official visit or a state visit", "gist": "The inviting country decides visit type (working, official, state)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It is all a question of perspective", "gist": "The classification depends on perspective"}]}
